en: Wombats are small, round animals from Australia.
ja: ウォンバットはオーストラリアにいる、小さくて丸っこい動物。
answer: Wombats are small, round animals from Australia.

en: They look cute and a little sleepy.
ja: 見た目はかわいくて、ちょっと眠そう。
answer: They look cute and a little sleepy.

en: But they have a very strange secret.
ja: でも、すごく変わった秘密があるんだ。
answer: But they have a very strange secret.

en: Their poop is shaped like cubes!
ja: なんとうんこがサイコロ型！
answer: Their poop is shaped like cubes!

ja: そう、読み間違いじゃないよ。

en: Wombat poop has flat sides and corners.
ja: ウォンバットのうんこには平らな面と角がある。
answer: Wombat poop has flat sides and corners.

en: It looks a bit like tiny dice.
ja: ちっちゃいサイコロみたいな感じ。
answer: It looks a bit like tiny dice.

en: Each cube is about two centimeters wide.
ja: 1個の大きさは2センチくらい。
answer: Each cube is about two centimeters wide.

en: One wombat can make around 100 cubes every night.
ja: 1匹で毎晩100個くらい出すこともある。
answer: One wombat can make around 100 cubes every night.

en: For a long time, nobody knew why.
ja: 長いあいだ、その理由は誰にもわからなかった。
answer: For a long time, nobody knew why.

en: Some people thought wombats had square bottoms.
ja: お尻が四角いんじゃないかと思う人もいた。
answer: Some people thought wombats had square bottoms.
